noShortcutsRegisteredForContext: Ba a yi rajistar gajerun hanyoyi don wannan mahallin ba.
aboutIntro: Gajerun hanyoyin madannai, koyarwa, al'umma da ƙari don taimaka maka koyo da bunƙasa HAX.
haxDescription: HAX tsarin rubutu ne na asalin yanar gizo da aka tsara don wallafa abun ciki mai sauƙin isa kuma mai sassa a cikin wurare da yawa na isarwa.
keyboardShortcutsDescription: An yi rajista a tsakiya a HAXcms kuma ana nunawa bisa mahallin da ke aiki. Haɗe-haɗe suna amfani da Ctrl+Shift+[Maɓalli]; a cikin edita, rubuta alamar markdown sannan sarari yana canza toshen. Rubuta {slash} a cikin toshen rubutu mara komai don buɗe Bincike a layi.
searchShortcutBrowserPath: Hanyar mai binciken gajerun hanyoyi a Bincike:
tutorialsDescription: Fara da ayyuka masu jagora, sannan ka koma zuwa koyarwa mataki-mataki.
apiLinksDescription: HAXcms na iya wallafa shafuka a tsare-tsaren da suka dace da na'ura don kayan aikin LLM su iya karantawa da sarrafa abun cikinka da ƙarancin tsaftacewa.
apiLinksFormats: Ƙara {formats} a URLs na shafuka don neman wasu sigogin shafi.
apiLinksLlms: Yi amfani da {llms} a matsayin fihirisa ga samfura don wannan gidan yanar gizo, tare da hanyoyin haɗi zuwa muhimman albarkatun da na'ura ke iya karantawa.
apiLinksPair: Haɗa {siteJson} (tsari) da {searchIndex} (dawo da bayanai) don ingantattun ayyukan da AI ke sarrafawa.
apiLinksOpenapi: Bincika yarjejeniyar API na gidan yanar gizo a {openapi}.
